course.title: Elements of Civil Engineering Structures
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A reinforced concrete slab is built monolithically with its supports and consists of two equal spans each with a clear span of 18 ft. The service load is 90 psf and also the slab has to support a uniform load of 30 psf. 4000 psi concrete and 60,000 psi steel are specified for the slab. Design the slab by WSD method.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2018
